item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_organization.go","line":18,"priority":1,"description":"Late attachment only requires Planning to be nil; it does not require the work-level Profile to be nil or canonical. A materialized work with an existing launch profile passes every pristine-task check, then configurePreparedOrganization silently overwrites that profile. Refuse any pre-existing work-level organization state without mutation and add a regression covering Profile set before attachment."},{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_organization.go","line":151,"priority":1,"description":"Managed-repository configuration mutates the filesystem before the enclosing SQL transaction commits. If a later work/event/preparation/receipt write fails or loses a concurrency race, SQL rolls back but repository.git and its manifests remain. A corrected retry with another repository selection is then refused as already frozen, so the operation is not atomic and rejection can mutate persistent state. Stage/finalize the repository consistently with transaction outcome or provide verified rollback/recovery, with a failure injected after repository creation."}],"limitations":["Review used only the supplied sources and evidence, as requested; no tests or source state were independently inspected or reproduced.","The reported tests used an overlay excluding three unspecified dirty files, so compatibility with the complete checkout is not established.","No injected post-filesystem/pre-commit failure evidence was supplied for managed-repository attachment."]}
